title: 리딩인사이드 스타터 UNIT 07 Sports 문장
source: Reading Inside Starter Answer Key — 구문 해설 인용문 + 워크북 WRITING TEST 정답 청크(해석은 교재 해석 발췌)

grammar.evidence: R1 Check Up: nicer than · R2 Check Up: harder than · WB GRAMMAR TEST A bigger/better/heavier/more interesting, B than/more difficult/harder, C higher than/faster than/worse than/wiser than

sentences.title: On Ice? No, Underwater!
sentences.en: But next time you want to play hockey, go to a swimming pool instead.
sentences.ko: 하지만 다음에 하키를 하고 싶을 때는, 대신 수영장에 가 봐라.

sentences.title: On Ice? No, Underwater!
sentences.en: They also use hockey sticks to push the puck, …
sentences.ko: 그들은 또한 퍽을 밀어내기 위해 하키용 스틱을 쓴다.

sentences.title: On Ice? No, Underwater!
sentences.en: Before the game, the puck is placed in the middle of the pool.
sentences.ko: 경기 전에, 퍽은 수영장 중앙에 놓인다.

sentences.title: On Ice? No, Underwater!
sentences.en: This is because it is safer than ice hockey or field hockey.
sentences.ko: 이는 그것이 아이스하키나 필드하키보다 더 안전하기 때문이다.

sentences.title: On Ice? No, Underwater!
sentences.en: You might be surprised to hear that there are even players in their 70s!
sentences.ko: 심지어 70대인 선수들이 있다는 것을 들으면 당신은 놀랄지도 모른다!
sentences.point: 감정 원인의 to부정사 + that 명사절 목적어

sentences.title: The Trampoline Effect
sentences.en: If he uses a wooden bat, the ball will fly about 150 meters.
sentences.ko: 만약 그가 나무 방망이를 사용하면, 공은 약 150미터를 날아갈 것이다.

sentences.title: The Trampoline Effect
sentences.en: This causes the ball to lose some of its kinetic energy.
sentences.ko: 이는 공이 운동 에너지의 일부를 잃게 한다.

sentences.title: The Trampoline Effect
sentences.en: It’s like bouncing a ball on soft grass.
sentences.ko: 그것은 부드러운 잔디 위에서 공이 튀어 오르게 하는 것과 같다.

sentences.title: The Trampoline Effect
sentences.en: This makes the ball go farther.
sentences.ko: 이것은 공이 더 멀리 나아가게 한다.

quiz.q: Underwater hockey sticks are ____ than ice hockey sticks. (short)
This swimming pool is ____ than that one. (big)
This book is ____ than that one. (interesting)
A metal bat sends the ball farther. It is ____ than a wooden bat for hitting home runs. (good)
Underwater hockey is (safer / more safe) than ice hockey.
My bat is heavier (than / then) yours.
Today is more hot than yesterday.
